description: This file is an assembly source code implementing a MIPS startup routine for a specific embedded environment, specifically a compressed kernel loader for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards. It includes low-level hardware initialization, cache management, relocations, and jump to a decompression routine.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Entry point for initializing the system, including cache setup, memory initialization, and branching to decompression routine.
